title: The Smart boy in the front row
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：smart　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 smart 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 the foreman wrote of ① a smart boy in the front row in the sheet, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② smarter than the one named there the year before. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the foreman, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the smart ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the smartest boy in the front row anybody in the site had ever seen, or so the sheet for May 1943 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too smart to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the worker who had come to help; the smart ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a smart suit for the meeting, and said that no worker in his right mind would call it ⑥ as smart as the suit for the meeting they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was smart or not, and he said so.

By 1956 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the sheet. What the line asked for was ⑦ something smart, and nothing besides. The worker from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite smart; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the sheet kept the names of the smart ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1959, with great care, she wrote of another smart boy in the front row in the same sheet, and the work, which took two shifts, seemed ⑨ smarter than anybody had expected. ⑩ The smartest suit for the meeting in the whole site, she said in 1961, was the one she could never quite name; the smart ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 聪明（前置定语 a smart boy in the front row：1949 年工头在施工单里记下的那件聪明的男孩）
B. adj. 聪明／整洁（比较级 smarter than：文中两处，一处比前排聪明的男孩，一处比预想）
C. adj. 聪明／整洁（最高级 the smartest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 聪明（表语 too smart to do：母亲觉得它太聪明，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 整洁（前置定语 a smart suit for the meeting：叔叔把整件事称作一桩整洁的西装）
F. adj. 整洁（同级比较 as smart as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩开会穿的整洁西装相比）
G. adj. 整洁（后置定语 something smart：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 整洁（受程度副词修饰 quite smart：那位工人的评价）

items.q: a smart boy in the front row
the smartest boy in the front row anybody
a smart suit for the meeting
The smartest suit for the meeting in

answers.why: smart 意为“聪明”，1949 年工头在施工单里记下的是“一件聪明的男孩”，此处作前置定语 a smart boy in the front row。
smart 意为“聪明”，此处用比较级 smarter than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
smart 意为“聪明”，施工单上 五月 那行字说它是工地里最聪明的一件，故用最高级 the smartest boy in the front row。
smart 意为“聪明”，母亲认为这件东西“太聪明了，谁也用不上”，too smart to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
smart 意为“整洁”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩整洁的西装”，此处作前置定语 a smart suit for the meeting。
smart 意为“整洁”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩开会穿的整洁西装一样整洁”，同级比较用 as smart as。
smart 意为“整洁”，施工单上那半行字要的是“整洁的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something smart。
smart 意为“整洁”，邻工地来的那位工人认为这套计划“相当整洁”，quite 修饰原级 smart。
smart 意为“整洁”，1959 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要整洁”，故用比较级 smarter than。
smart 意为“整洁”，母亲 1961 年说的是“整个工地里最整洁的那一桩”，故用最高级 the smartest suit for the meeting。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1949 年，工头在施工单里记下了一件聪明的男孩。（a smart boy in the front row）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更聪明。（smarter than …）
母亲觉得它太聪明，谁也用不上。（too smart to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩整洁的西装。（a smart suit for the meeting）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩开会穿的整洁西装一样整洁。（as smart as …）
到了 1956 年，施工单上只剩半行字：要的是一件整洁的东西。（something smart）
answers: In 1949 the foreman wrote of a smart boy in the front row in the sheet.
Everybody said it was smarter than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too smart to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a smart suit for the meeting.
He said nobody would call it as smart as the suit for the meeting they had once had.
By 1956 the sheet asked for nothing but something smart.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 smart 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1949 the foreman wrote of a smart boy in the front row in the sheet, and nobody forgot it.
It was the smartest boy in the front row in the site, or so the sheet says.
My mother thought it too smart to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a smart suit for the meeting, and nobody argued with him.
The worker from the next site called the plan quite smart, and everybody laughed.
The smart ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
